Decision RESOLVED by the coordinator (2026-11-12); not escalated further. This closes the open Decision in the 2026-11-11 22:00 PST triage comment.
- The ~11.5% false-fire measurement was taken on anthropic:claude-opus-4-8. origin/main's src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/code-review-tests.eval.yaml now pins anthropic:claude-opus-5-5 (epochs: 3), so that measurement no longer describes the gate.
- Next: rebase the salvaged AC1-AC4 diff onto current main, then re-measure with the full 3-epoch run, no case cap, inside a gate_source session, on the current pin.
- If AC5 passes: land AC1-AC5 together.
- If it still misses: option (1), widen the fix to calibrate the false-positive guards until AC5 passes. AC5 is not rewritten, and wontfix does not apply to a live defect.
- The remeasurement is recorded on this ticket as evidence.
